set.st: In September 1905 George Brown struck an iron pot of about $500 in gold and silver coins, all dated before 1860, while cutting corn on his rented land in the Hyde Park addition of Des Moines; the pot was taken up. It was thought a farmer who went to the Civil War had buried it and never came back. No further find was reported. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.tovw: Lead grade F: the pot was recovered in 1905 and nothing is reported left; one wire story in many papers
set.t: Recovered 1905; Hyde Park addition is built over. Urban: look only.

src: Quad-City Times (Davenport), 4 Oct 1905, p. 1 (Newspapers.com 299448781); same wire in 13 Iowa papers 4-6 Oct 1905
